notes: The inverse counterpart to excluir-estabelecimento.html (WMS-9 Z1-Z6): wipes every transactional concept (Movimento, Recebimento, Expedicao and their owned children, CrossDocking links, DocumentoFiscal drafts) and zeroes LocalArmazenagemLote occupancy, leaving master data/structure untouched. Unlike excluir-estabelecimento.html's client-side per-id DELETE loop, this page makes exactly ONE call -- a server-side procedure invocation that runs the whole cascade atomically -- gated by a type-to-confirm control (the DSL has no built-in confirmation primitive). The procedure is deliberately not wired into any autoPanel action, so this page is its only entry point; 'Movimento' in the invoke URL is just a valid aggregate name the shared /invoke/{procedure} endpoint requires to resolve context, not a hint that the procedure operates on one Movimento record.
